officialSources.governedRows: coursework, mixed-mode, research, MBA and Master of Architecture rows

publicDisplayRules: Coursework master rows display CPA 2.50/4.00 as the structured GPA gate and retain the official below-2.50 working-experience route in the academic requirement note.
Mixed-mode and research master rows display CPA 2.75/4.00 as the structured GPA gate and retain the official 2.50 < CPA < 2.75 internal-assessment route plus below-2.50 working-experience route.
ODL master rows display minimum CGPA 2.5/4.0 from the ODL official admission page.
MBA and Master of Architecture rows retain their official special GPA/CPA and working-experience partitions instead of the generic master rule.

sampleRows.displayEvidence: UTM official coursework master rule: CPA Scale of 4 at 2.50 or higher requires no working experience; CPA below 2.50 requires 5 years related working experience.

sampleRows.nameEnOfficial: Master of Philosophy Field of Research : Software Engineering
sampleRows.displayEvidence: UTM official mixed-mode/research master rule: CPA Scale of 4 at 2.75 or higher requires no working experience; 2.50 < CPA < 2.75 is subject to rigorous internal assessment.
UTM official MBA rule: CPA 3.50 and above no working experience; CPA 3.00 to 3.49 requires 2 years; CPA 2.00 to 2.99 requires 5 years.
UTM ODL official admission rule: recognised Bachelor's Degree with good honours with minimum CGPA 2.5/4.0 or equivalent.
UTM official Master of Architecture rule keeps CPA 3.0-4.0, 2.7-2.99, 2.5-2.69 and 2.3-2.49 working-experience partitions plus LAM Part 1 requirement.
